mapper.select: select a.DETAILUUID, a.PBC_PROD_ID, a.TERMID, a.ASSET_TYPE, a.PRRTY_PROD_TYPE, a.PRRTY_ORG_CODE, a.PRRTY_PROD_ID, a.CCY, a.AMT, a.AMT_CNY, a.SUBMIT_TIME, a.PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, a.SUBMIT_DEADLINE, a.STATUS, a.SEND_STATUS, a.STATUS_DATE, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.ORG_CODE, a.DEPT_CODE, a.CREATE_DEPT, a.PROD_ID from PBC_COL_SPE_COUNTER_PARTY_SUB a where a.TERMID =(select TERMID from PBC_COL_SPE_COUNTER_PARTY_SUB b where b.DETAILUUID=#{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ORDER BY TERMID,a.PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE ASC, a.UPDATE_TIME DESC,a.PBC_PROD_ID,ASSET_TYPE,PRRTY_PROD_TYPE,PRRTY_PROD_ID

select aa.pbcProjectCodeExternal as code, aa.prodName as name, aa.prodName as shortName from( SELECT insideProdId, ifnull(max(pbcProjectCodeExternal),max(pbcProjectCodeSystem)) pbcProjectCodeExternal, s.prodName FROM (select t1.INSIDE_PROD_ID as insideProdId, t1.PBC_CODE as pbcProjectCodeExternal, t2.PBC_PROD_ID as pbcProjectCodeSystem, t2.prod_name as prodName from PBC_PROD_ASSETPOOL_CODE t1 left join PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_SUB t2 on t1.INSIDE_PROD_ID = t2.PROD_ID where t1.STATUS ='E' ) s group by insideProdId )aa
aa.pbcProjectCodeExternal like concat('%',#{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

select POS.PRODID as prodId, pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID as prrtyProdId, pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE as prrtyOrgCode, pos.CCY as ccy, SUM(ifnull(cabd.TDY_COST_AMT,0)+ifnull(cabd.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+ifnull(cabd.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) as amt, cai.ASSET_TYPE2 as chbAssetType2, POS.ASSET_TYPE1 as pbcAssetType1, POS.ASSET_TYPE2 as pbcAssetType2, POS.ASSET_TYPE3 as pbcAssetType3, PINFO.pbc_code as pbcProdId from PBC_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POS inner join (select distinct ifnull(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as pbc_code,inside_prod_id as prodid from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID ) PINFO ON PINFO.prodid = POS.prodid left join PBC_SPE_COUNTER_PARTY pscp on pscp.ASSET_CODE =pos.ASSET_CODE and pscp.STATUS in('E','M') left join chb_asset_info cai on cai.ASSET_CODE =pos.ASSET_CODE and cai.STATUS in('E','M') left join chb_assets_basis_data cabd on cabd.ASSET_ID =pos.ASSET_CODE and cabd.STATUS in('E','M') and to_char(cabd.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{executeDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} where (pos.ASSET_TYPE1 ='P05' and pos.ASSET_TYPE2 ='R01' and pos.ASSET_TYPE3 in('L08','L09','L10','L11','L12','L13','L14','L15') or pos.ASSET_TYPE1 ='P07' and pos.ASSET_TYPE2 ='T02' and pos.ASSET_TYPE3 in('M01','M02','M03','M04','M05','M06','M07','M08')) /**add 3.2.8 ZG08 特定目的载体交易对手明细信息 需求变更 by dxy 20230206 start*/ and (cabd.POS_AMT+cabd.TDY_COST_AMT+cabd.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL+cabd.TDY_INTINCEXP) >0 /**add 3.2.8 ZG08 特定目的载体交易对手明细信息 需求变更 by dxy 20230206 end*/ and pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID is not null and pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE is not null and PINFO.pbc_code is not null and to_char(pos.ENDDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{executeDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by POS.PRODID,pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID,pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE,pos.CCY,cai.ASSET_TYPE2, POS.ASSET_TYPE1,POS.ASSET_TYPE2,POS.ASSET_TYPE3,PINFO.pbc_code

select pti.account as prodId, pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID as prrtyProdId, pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE as prrtyOrgCode, pti.ccy as ccy, sum(pti.qty) as amt, pti.HOLDER_TYPE as chbHolderType, PINFO.pbc_code as pbcProdId from PBC_Target_INFO pti left join PBC_SPE_COUNTER_PARTY pscp on pscp.ASSET_CODE =pti.INDENTIFY_MARK inner join (select distinct ifnull(t2.pbc_code,a.PBC_PROD_ID) as pbc_code,ifnull(inside_prod_id,a.PROD_ID) as prodid from pbc_col_prd_baseinfo_sub a LEFT JOIN( SELECT inside_prod_id, pbc_code FROM pbc_prod_assetpool_code WHERE status='E' AND code_type='01' )t2 ON t2.inside_prod_id=a.PROD_ID ) PINFO ON PINFO.prodid = pti.account where pti.STATUS in('E','M') and pti.HOLDER_TYPE in('17','18','19','20','21','22') and pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID is not null and pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE is not null and pti.ccy is not null and PINFO.pbc_code is not null and to_char(pti.hold_date,'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{executeDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by pti.account ,pscp.PARTY_PROD_ID,pscp.PARTY_ORG_CODE,pti.ccy,pti.HOLDER_TYPE,PINFO.pbc_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pbc_col_spe_counter_party_sub (DETAILUUID, PBC_PROD_ID, TERMID, ASSET_TYPE, PRRTY_PROD_TYPE, PRRTY_ORG_CODE, PRRTY_PROD_ID, CCY, AMT, AMT_CNY, SUBMIT_TIME, PBC_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, SUBMIT_DEADLINE, STATUS, SEND_STATUS, STATUS_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_DEPT, PROD_ID) VALUES(#{detailuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{pbcProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{termid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{prrtyProdType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prrtyOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prrtyProdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{amtCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL},NULL, #{pbcSubmitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{submitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} , #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{statusDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
delete from pbc_col_spe_counter_party_sub where send_status='01' and TERMID=#{termId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from pbc_col_spe_counter_party_sub where send_status='03' and TERMID=#{termId}
